records.title: Coinbase Q3 2026 earnings results and operating metrics
records.summary: Coinbase's October 29 Q3 release reports 10.7% crypto trading volume market share and a fourth consecutive quarter of share gains; average USDC held in Coinbase products of $22B, approximately 30% of average USDC market capitalization and 49% year-over-year growth; prediction markets above $200M annualized revenue; 179% two-year compound annual growth in crypto derivatives volume; 12.5% share of total crypto market capitalization in Assets on Platform; Q3 GAAP net income $718.7M, adjusted net income $77.7M and adjusted EBITDA $332.9M. These are company-reported metrics.
records.limitations: Management-reported metrics are not independent third-party measurements; annualized prediction-market revenue is a run rate, not recognized Q3 revenue. The quarter ended 2026-09-30, before Coinbase's RLUSD launch on 2026-10-28. Average USDC held is a platform balance measure, not net new external capital or XRP purchases. Q3 metrics cannot measure post-listing RLUSD substitution or incremental XRP demand.
